visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a static extreme close-up of golden-brown fried chicken wings piled on a white plate, showcasing a crispy, textured coating. Reddish spice powder is visible on the surface. (2) Two hands wearing transparent gloves appear, stretching and examining a raw, pale chicken wing over a light-colored wooden cutting board. (3) The scene shifts to a glass bowl filled with raw chicken wings. A hand adds minced garlic, sugar, and reddish-brown spice powder from small glass containers into the bowl. The lighting is bright and even. (4) The hands mix the chicken and seasonings thoroughly. A dark liquid is poured from a bottle, followed by the addition of white starch. (5) A hand skewers the marinated chicken wings onto thin bamboo sticks on the wooden board. (6) A man with short black hair, wearing a white chef's jacket with pink floral patterns on the sleeves and collar, appears from the chest up against a white brick wall background, gesturing with his hands while speaking. (7) In a glass bowl, white flour is mixed with water, followed by the addition of salt, white pepper, and several clear ice cubes. A whisk is used to stir the mixture into a thick, white batter. (8) The skewered chicken wings are dipped into the batter, coating them in a thin, wet layer. (9) The wings are lowered into a black frying pan filled with bubbling hot oil. Large bubbles surround the chicken as it fries. Yellow tongs are used to turn the wings. (10) The chef returns to the frame, speaking and gesturing towards the pan. (11) Red and white spice powders are combined in a small glass bowl and stirred with a metal spoon. (12) The final shot returns to the crispy, golden fried chicken wings, highlighting their texture.
